## Description
Provide a concise explanation of what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Code refactoring

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project (`ruff check .`, `mypy app/`)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes (`pytest`)
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation in `docs/` where necessary
- [ ] No confidential, proprietary, or live taxpayer data is included in test fixtures
